depositToFRLM((address,address,uint24,in.details: This function optimizes gas by having the FRLM pull tokens directly from the caller      rather than transferring tokens through the Spot contract. The caller needs to approve      token spending directly to the FRLM contract, not to Spot.

params.key: The pool key for the pool
